function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a text file and send it to the user. Use this when the user asks you to generate code, a website, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, notes, or any downloadable text file. Call once per file, or pass several files at once. Allowed extensions: html, css, js, txt, json, md.

filename.description: File name including extension, for example index.html, styles.css, script.js, notes.txt

files.description: Optional list of files to write in one call
